title: RSI deep-buy: layer confluence vote at the RSI low (card rsi-deep-confluence, af9dbfeeb)

what.name: Event
what.value_plain: same Step F event (RSI14 at or below L after 3+ above), fill = next bar open
what.label: OURS

what.name: Voters (6, pre-registered)
what.value_plain: higher-TF RSI band, Bollinger position, Kurisko quad-rotation turn, taker-buy share z, prior-day level sweep and reclaim, causal pivot divergence on the next TF up; same TF plus two TFs above
what.label: OURS

what.name: Schemes
what.value_plain: 15: same-TF score, higher-TF score, total, add-one and drop-one per voter; equal weights, no learned weights
what.label: OURS

what.name: Not voting (no causal bar history)
what.value_plain: WaveTrend, trendline / pitchfork, Krown, CryptoCred, Tom / Fabio order flow, funding / OI
what.label: OURS

what.name: Keep rule
what.value_plain: DEV delta log-loss > 0 and Holm p < 0.05 over 120 tests, then VALIDATION delta > 0
what.label: OURS

how: 15 schemes x 4 RSI TFs x 2 outcomes = 120 tests; score cells shrunk to the level-only table F0; fee-net EV per day per bucket against the level-only row.
window: DEV = bar open < 2024-07-01 (frozen first); VALIDATION 2024-07-01..2025-06-30 read once; HOLDOUT never read

verdict.label: WEAK NULL: 10 of 120 kept by the rule, all on the 1m price outcome, VALIDATION t under 1; nothing on 5m, 15m or 1h

why: DEV t near 7.9 on the kept 1m tests, VALIDATION t 0.81 and 0.75: a strong in-sample pattern that does not carry.
Gains are about 1e-4 nats per event; the level-only table F0 stays the working answer.
Half the layers the operator means by confluence (WaveTrend, trendlines, Tom / Fabio flow) could not vote: no stamped bar-by-bar causal history exists for them yet.
